## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share the release train.
- can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
- Run the procedure 'Monthly payroll run 2025-03' in between other work. Run the listed steps in order, one at a time.
- Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Sandbox payments moved to `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use `sbx-pay-c`.

## Current objective
Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, which is double-counting refunds. The tenacity refactor is superseded until next sprint. Payroll remains an interleaved task.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Keep local decimal formatting in `_format_lines()`: `format_money()` already provides locale-aware grouping.
- Calculate row/page heights as raw points divided ad hoc by `72`: reservations were inconsistent.
- Re-reserve the table header on every page: it caused avoidable wrapping and made the 86-item test require 3 pages instead of 2.
- Continue using `declarative_base()`: replaced with `DeclarativeBase`.
- Disable idempotency middleware: it produced duplicate invoices in staging.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Investigate refund double-counting. Next exact command: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`
- [pending] Implement a small refund fix and focused regression test; run focused tests, then `pytest -q`.
- [pending] Payroll steps 6–8; exact commands were not retained, so status is unknown.
- [status unknown] `ruff format --check ledgerly/billing/pdf.py tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`; no result was recorded.
- [pending] Investigate scheduler DST failure only after reconciliation unless the operator reprioritizes it.

## Recent work
Structured logging now includes `request_id`; invoice/payment logging and tests were updated. Full-suite result was exactly `142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed`; the health-log expectation was fixed and its 4 tests passed. A separate scheduler run was `7 passed, 1 failed` because a 09:00 recurring invoice executed at 10:00 across the March DST transition.
